title: A waterfront view  of Seville
text: It’s a rather quick boat ride, but it’s a lovely boat and he served wine and we had a wonderful time!
author: Suzanne_L

title: Family cruise
text: Perfect relaxing cruise. Perfect way to see the city from the river. Staff was amazing and a pleasure
author: Joseph_L

title: Great Experience
text: I very much enjoyed this experience and highly recommend it. I planned this private river cruise to propose to my girlfriend, and it was exactly what I imagined. This is a spacious boat, but it still feels cozy. The ride is smooth and the seats are comfortable. We were offered the option to have a tourist cruise or a private cruise with the music of our choice. Again, highly recommend!
author: U9265QKjustinp

title: A must-do experience in Sevilla!
text: A truly fabulous experience! Even on a gloomy day, we had an amazing time. We enjoyed learning from our private guide, Gabriel, who was excellent and even offered to take several photos of us. The photo opportunities were spectacular. The price of this private cruise is incredibly reasonable. We highly recommend this activity!
author: J3478KOadamm

title: Wonderful
text:
We were so happy we chose to do this cruise! It was so relaxing, beautiful and informative. The electric boat was so quiet and peaceful. Our captain was subservient and professional!
We highly recommend it!!
author: Carol S

title: Seville from privat boat tour
text:
We decided to do a boat tour in Seville and as the privat toura are for up to 11 persons and we were 11 we immediatley decided to do it. And it was good choice. The boat ture for 11 persons 1 hour was 16 eur per person. The ride was cozy, we listened to prerecorded information about the sights and overall enjoyed ourselfs. Good way to learn and see Seville from different perspective.

The only note, the directionst where to meet the person for the tour are not correct , so double check by the river bank insted of where it is written you should meet them...the directons seem to be a bit outdate
author: Mojca15

title: A unique sunset
text: We took a family cruise on the guadalquivir on Saturday evening with Tino as crew member. He gave us the most enjoyable tour answering with great grace and art all our questions. We give the whole family a 10. An endearing experience. Seville how beautiful you are.
author: esme120

title: Great Trip
text: Great trip and so peaceful. A little more expensive than a regular boat but not having an engine meant no noise and no carbon footprint
author: JoanneB2477

title: Turtle tour
text:
Great little private tour. Even saw turtles!
Clean boat. Friendly staff. Thoroughly recommend. There were four of us so plenty of space.
author: anthony_l

title: On The River in Seville
text:
It was a lovely day for a boat ride. We were a group of 6 and had the boat all to ourselves.
The boatsman was friendly and helpful but not a lot of English. One of the group was fluent in Spanish and he did the discussion with the boatsman.
It was a nice way to chill and see Seville.
author: mfleischer2017
